हैलोवीन के खास मौके पर जाह्नवी कपूर ने अपनी मां दिवंगत एक्ट्रेस श्रीदेवी को एक बेहद स्पेशल ट्रिब्यूट दिया है! 🐍

जाह्नवी ने 1986 की ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म Nagina से अपनी मां के सबसे यादगार और आइकॉनिक नागिन वाले लुक को रीक्रिएट किया है। इस लुक के लिए उन्होंने गुलाबी आउटफिट, ज्वेलरी, मेकअप और हेयरस्टाइल को हूबहू मैच किया।

पोस्टर और अमरीश पूरी वाले BTS सीन को दोबारा बनाने में Orry ने भी जाह्नवी की मदद की। जाह्नवी ने पोस्ट में लिखा कि हैलोवीन पर अपने पसंदीदा किरदारों को ट्रिब्यूट दिया जाता है और मम्मी, ऋषि कपूर व अमरीश सर से ज्यादा आइकॉनिक कोई नहीं हो सकता। 1986 में आई यह फिल्म उस साल की दूसरी सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली फिल्म थी।

बता दें कि 24 फरवरी 2018 को दुबई में एक शादी के दौरान श्रीदेवी का अचानक निधन हो गया था, जिसके कुछ ही महीनों बाद जुलाई 2018 में जाह्नवी कपूर की पहली फिल्म Dhadak रिलीज हुई थी। ❤️✨

क्या आपको जाह्नवी का यह Nagina हैलोवीन अवतार पसंद आया? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.title: Janhvi Kapoor recreates mom Sridevi’s Nagina look for Halloween, calls it one of the most iconic movie moments ever
ctx.summary: Sridevi starred as the lead in Nagina, the 1986 Indian fantasy romance film which cemented her as the biggest female star of the era.
ctx.text:
It is Halloween time and Bollywood stars are in the mood for celebration! Actor Janhvi Kapoor has taken the challenge for Halloween and recreated one of the most iconic looks of her mother, late actor Sridevi 's career. She dressed as Nagina, the character made iconic by Sridevi in 1986.
Janhvi matched the pink outfit, the jewelry, the make-up and the hair-do to recreate the iconic look of Sridevi from Nagina. She also got the help of Orry to recreate the poster, the BTS scene with Amrish Puri, and another scene from the film.
In the caption, Janhvi wrote, "Happy Halloweeeeeny 👻 had to recreate one of the most iconic movie moments everrrrr 🐍🤍✨
So much of Halloween has become about dressing up as your favourite characters and pop culture moments. Sometimes they’re spooky, sometimes they’re funny, and sometimes it’s a tribute ❤️
And who could possibly be more iconic than Mumma, Rishi uncle and Amrish sir!! 🥹🤍Got a little help from 🤫😉💄 for the lewk"
Sridevi played an ‘icchadhaari nagin’ - a snake that can take any form it wishes - in the film that is a revenge saga. She was appreciated for her portrayal of the character and the film became the second highest grosser of the year (as per an IMDB list). Nagina is also the first Indian film to get a sequel, Nigahein, though the sequel did not work at the box office. Nagina propelled the career of Sridevi to superstardom and made her the most bankable female star in the industry.
Sridevi passed away on 24 February 2018 in Dubai, where she had travelled to attend a family wedding. At just 54, her life was tragically cut short due to accidental drowning, leaving her family, the film industry and millions of fans in deep shock. Her untimely demise came only months before her daughter Janhvi Kapoor’s much-anticipated Bollywood debut with Dhadak in July, making the loss even more poignant.
Janhvi was recently seen in the episode of Koffee with Karan season 9. Janhvi opened up about the controversy surrounding her role in Telugu film Peddi, saying she should have been more assertive in expressing her discomfort with the sexualisation and problematic portrayal of her character.
